parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle of the faucet, typically made of brass for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the flow of water by rotating to open or close the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to regulate water flow.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the faucet, made of brass to provide structural integrity and resist corrosion.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal valve and connects the switch and spout, ensuring water flows through the correct path.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support for other parts.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the outlet part of the faucet, made of brass for durability and water resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of water from the faucet to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during operation.
